title: day-of-staff-ops-expense-quirks
notes:
Day-of quick journal + expense quirks (for whoever is filling for me)

Quick summary: capture receipts, notarize weird cash tips, avoid foreign-ATM fee surprises, label everything with "'Redwood - booth X'" for returns. This is a raw checklist + odd-cases log — save a copy to Confluence after event if we lock process.

Essentials to remind staff:
- Company card in pouch: primary for vendor invoices (AV, shipping). If you must use personal card, take photo of receipt AND write name of payer on receipt.
- Receipts: photo immediately. Slack channel #events-expenses -> drop photo with attendee name + line item. Forward emailed receipts to expenses@redwood.com with subject: EVT-<city>-<date>-<vendor>.
- Per-diem: domestic tech crew: $60/day (breakfast/lunch/dinner combined). International per-diem handled case-by-case — pre-approve via manager reply to this thread.
- Taxis/rides: prefer company Uber for Business. If local cash taxi used, get paper receipt + license plate and driver name (some countries require that to reimburse).

Common weird cases (what actually happened last time):
1) Booth handoff fee charged by venue as "booth labour". Invoice often on venue portal under different legal name — escalate to Jordan who has venue legal mapping.
2) FedEx/third-party pickup charged to personal cards by logistics leads — must submit an itemized shipping invoice or we cannot rebill to Redwood to avoid foreign VAT issues.
3) Tip rounding: some locales add service automatically. If tip included on digital receipt, mark "service included" in expense form to avoid double-tipping.

Vendor contacts (bring printed card):
- Harbor Logistics (crate shipping + forklift): Priya Rao, operations lead, +1-415-555-0192, priya@harbor-logi.com. Bring pickup code: HBRD-2987.
- StageCraft AV (onsite AV + internet): Marcus Lee, +1-212-555-0144, orders@stagecraft-av.com. Confirm dedicated line SLA before noon day 0.
- Local courier (last-mile showfloor): GimmeRides Logistics — contact Ana Torres +44-20-555-0168 (EU events only). Expect surge rates on weekends.

Day-of checklist (one-page):
- Packing: labels on every case (Redwood | booth 2C).
- Loading dock arrival window: 0700-0900. Call Priya on arrival for forklift.
- Onsite crew: check-in at organizer table -> get 1-day staff badges (bring driver license).
- Confirm WiFi SSID + pass with Marcus; test streaming hook.
- Meals: order group lunch for staff 12:00-13:00 (pre-approve bill via company card).

Expenses entry quick rules:
- Use expense code EVT-OPS-2025 (GL: 5402) for on-site labor + incidentals.
- Shipping: include tracking and packing list; if FedEx invoice missing, ask Harbor for consolidated shipper invoice.
- Missing receipt: submit Missing Receipt Form (link in Confluence) and attach manager approval screenshot. Limit $75 for missing-domestic-only; anything >$75 requires finance sign-off.

Tips + reminders to self:
- Cash advances: avoid unless absolutely necessary. If needed, capture cashier sign-off + initials.
- Hotel incidental charges: front-desk receipts only. Card folios take 48-72h to close; request itemized folio before checkout.
- Currency conversion: always include currency code (EUR/GBP) on expense line. Use bank rate + attach statement if conversion variance >$10.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Confirm whether we can use vendor "Harbor" as shipper on Redwood billing profile (finance to confirm). Ticket: EVT-4123.
- Add Marcus as preferred AV vendor in Confluence page under "approved_vendors".
- Update per-diem table for APAC for next quarter.

Random notes to remember (hand-off to next lead):
- If you get asked by venue for proof of insurance, copy Willis policy PDF from Confluence, file name: redwood-events-insurance.pdf.
- Keep a small envelope of USD $100 for cabs/tips at smaller venues (label envelope with initials and reconcile at end-of-day).

If anything goes sideways call: Jordan Reyes +1-415-555-0101 (primary coverage) or Samir Gupta +1-650-555-0109 (backup).

End of scratchpad — paste this into Confluence and tag @events-team when locked.
